    Nakayama-pair extraction from Iyama's finite ladder comparison #

    This file assembles the abstract categorical ingredients of the finite-ladder argument. A radical-power witness is restricted to an indecomposable summand, the reversed comparison identifies the terminal essential arrow, and the resulting positive-length certificate is truncated by one rung to produce a Nakayama pair.
